name: Penciljam Bengaluru at NGMA
description:
📆 25th Oct 2026
⏱️ 11:30 am - 1:00 pm
📍 NGMA, Bengaluru

Manikyavelu Mansion, once home to businessman-turned-aristocrat Vilum Manickavelu Mudaliar, was acquired by the government at an auction. Restored and repurposed, it became the southern centre of the National Gallery of Modern Art (NGMA) in 2009. Read more on NGMA here: https://drawingbengaluru.com/web/2025/08/the-national-gallery-of-modern-art-bengaluru/
How to join this session
You don't need artistic skill to participate in this event - just boundless curiosity and a love for drawing. To connect with other participants, please use our community on Discord.
https://penciljam.com/main/community/

If this is your first time and would like future update on events, and more. Please register here.

Once you arrive at the location, choose a spot you'd like to sketch and get comfortable.
Rules at this location
No large easels are not allowed within the Gallery.
No wet media allowed inside the gallery/exhibit spaces
Be mindful to not block the walking paths.
Things to carry for this session

 	A sketchbook/paper/drawing surface
 	Pencils or any medium you would like to try out
 	A portable chair/mat. If the location has no seating, we tend to sit on the ground

name: Sketchbook Saturday | Adithya Suresh
description:
About Sketchbook Saturday
Sketchbooks are private, and intimate space for artists to think, experiment, and try new ways of designing or creating art. Sketchbook Saturday is a bi-monthly event that sees artists from the Penciljam group sharing their Sketchbooks and creative process with the broader creative community.
Featuring Artist | Adithya Suresh
Adithya is a cybersecurity engineer working in Bengaluru, who has been interested in the art form of drawing since his childhood days inspired by cartoons and anime like Dragon Ball Z.

He loves to do live sketching and carries around his sketchbook wherever possible, documenting life as a form of memory keeping. His other interests include voice acting, listening to old songs and travelling.

Follow him on Instagram @sketchesbyadi
